text:
Max: Quick favor — can someone run a latency + KV-cache sweep for harbor-4b-quant on 2x A10G in us-west1? Need 1000 requests with seq=128. Three cache-hit profiles: 0%, 50%, 80%. Target p95 < 120ms. Collect numbers + exact command used. cc @Olivia @Sara
Olivia: On it. Which model tag — v1 or v1a?
Max: v1a (the quantized build with the new kernel selection).
BenchBot: allocation started — 2x A10G (us-west1), container=harbor-4b-quant:v1a, run_id=hb-4043, nodes_ready in ~1m
Sara: I can take the 0% and 50% passes, Olivia can do 80%. ETA ~10-12m for first numbers.
Olivia: I’ll do 80% after Sara posts 50% so we use same run_id for consistency.
Sara: kicking off 0% run now. command posted for reproducibility:
```
./run_bench --model=harbor-4b-quant:v1a --nodes=2 --seq=128 --requests=1000 --cache-hit=0 --batch=8 --run-id=hb-4043-0
```
Sara: 0% done — quick summary:
- mean=38ms
- p50=35ms
- p95=110ms
- p99=240ms
- tokens/sec=4200
notes: tail noisy on a small subset, might be preemption spikes or GC on host.
Olivia: saw the log tail: a couple of `nvlink` transient warnings but nothing fatal.
Evan: can we grab GPU util + mem snapshot for that run? want to see if backpressure contributes to tail.
Sara: yes — attaching the quick snapshot (copied inline): GPU0 util=79%, GPU1 util=77%, GPU0 mem_free=20480MB, GPU1 mem_free=20360MB, host CPU 45% avg.
Olivia: running 50% cache now with same batch and seq: command:
```
./run_bench --model=harbor-4b-quant:v1a --nodes=2 --seq=128 --requests=1000 --cache-hit=50 --batch=8 --run-id=hb-4043-50
```
Olivia: 50% results:
- mean=30ms
- p50=28ms
- p95=85ms
- p99=160ms
- tokens/sec=5400
notes: KV cache savings obvious; tail improved but p99 still elevated on some requests.
BenchBot: log excerpt: `eviction=0, cache_hits=497/1000, batch_size_dist=[4: 230, 8: 680, 16:90]`
Olivia: now kicking 80% run (will simulate warm prefixes).
Olivia: command:
```
./run_bench --model=harbor-4b-quant:v1a --nodes=2 --seq=128 --requests=1000 --cache-hit=80 --batch=8 --run-id=hb-4043-80
```
Olivia: 80% results:
- mean=26ms
- p50=24ms
- p95=68ms
- p99=145ms
- tokens/sec=6000
notes: p95 comfortably under 120ms, p99 still occasionally spikes but below 200ms for most samples.
Max: Nice work — p95 across profiles: 110 / 85 / 68. All within target p95<120ms. Quantized build looks good for latency.
Evan: can we compare to baseline fp16 run? what was baseline p95?
Max: baseline (harbor-4b-fp16) p95 ~95ms in our previous sweep, so quantized v1a adds some tail at 0% but improves ops at higher cache hit rates.
Sara: action: I can re-run 0% with batch=4 to see if smaller batches reduce p99 tail.
Olivia: I'll collect full logs and flamegraphs for the 0% run and drop into the perf ticket.
BenchBot: perf ticket created: PERF-1123, linked logs hb-4043-{0,50,80}, artifacts uploaded to s3://redwood-perf/hb-4043/
Max: plan sounds good. If Sara's batch=4 run brings p99 under 200ms at 0% we'll promote v1a to canary. Otherwise leave as rolling canary behind fp16.
Sara: starting batch=4 run now, ETA 8m.
Sara: batch=4 results (0%): mean=40ms, p50=37ms, p95=105ms, p99=190ms — p99 improved but still close to threshold.
Max: thanks — filing a follow-up to tweak kernel selection with research. :thumbsup:
Olivia: I'll open PERF-1124 with kernel tweak notes and assign to @Research infra.
Evan: nice short feedback loop. thanks all.
Max: closing thread — please add any extra notes to PERF-1123. :white_check_mark:
